verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI explicitly supports targeting multiple named agents (claude-code, codex, cursor, opencode, and 73+ more) via -a flags, writes per-agent skill files under ./<agent>/skills/ (or symlinks a canonical copy per-agent), and skills use even prints a per-harness generated prompt. Docs and GitHub explicitly market building a skill once and using it across any skills-compatible agent, with commands like -a claude-code -a opencode demonstrating multi-harness installs from a single collection. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification across all four named agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, others) simultaneously in one workflow is not shown, only individual flag examples and vendor docs.
